privacy-policy.intro: Your privacy matters to us. Learn how we collect, use, and protect your information.

blocks.text: Insta Biz Web (“we,” “our,” or “us”) is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you visit [https://www.instabizweb.com](/) or use our digital services. Please read this policy carefully. If you disagree with its terms, please discontinue use of our website.
Personal Information

items: Contact Information: Name, email address, phone number, business address
Business Information: Company name, industry, project requirements
Payment Information: Billing address, payment method details (processed securely via authorised gateways)
Communication Records: Messages, emails, and call logs related to our services

blocks.text: Technical Information

items: Website Usage: IP address, browser type, device information, pages visited
Cookies: Preferences, session data, analytics information
Performance Data: Website speed, user interactions, error logs

items.title: Service Delivery
items.body: To provide, maintain, and improve our digital solutions and services

items.title: Communication
items.body: To respond to enquiries, provide support, and send project updates

items.title: Payment Processing
items.body: To process payments and maintain billing records securely

items.title: Website Improvement
items.body: To analyse usage patterns and improve overall user experience

items.title: Legal Compliance
items.body: To comply with applicable laws, regulations, and court orders

items.title: Marketing (opt-in)
items.body: To send relevant updates if you have opted in to communications

blocks.text: We do not sell, trade, or rent your personal information to third parties. We may share your information only in the following circumstances:

items: Service Providers: Trusted partners who assist in service delivery (hosting, payment processing, analytics) under data protection agreements
Legal Requirements: When required by law, court order, or government regulations
Business Protection: To protect our rights, property, or safety, or that of our users
Business Transfers: In connection with any merger, sale, or acquisition of our business

blocks.text: We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your personal information:

items: SSL / TLS encryption for all data transmissions
Secure payment processing through authorised gateways only
Regular security audits and vulnerability assessments
Role-based access controls and authentication protocols
Automated data backup and disaster recovery procedures

blocks.text: We use cookies and similar technologies to enhance your browsing experience. You can control cookie settings through your browser preferences at any time.

items.def: Required for website functionality, authentication, and security. Cannot be disabled.
Help us understand website usage patterns to improve performance (e.g. Google Analytics).
Remember your settings and personalisation choices across sessions.
Used only with your consent to deliver relevant content and measure campaign effectiveness.
Request a copy of the personal information we hold about you
Request correction of inaccurate or incomplete information
Request deletion of your personal information (subject to legal obligations)
Request transfer of your data to another service provider
Object to processing of your data for marketing purposes at any time
Request restriction of processing while a complaint is being resolved

blocks.text: We retain your personal information for as long as necessary to provide our services and comply with legal obligations:

items.def: Duration of project + 3 years for support

blocks.text: Your information may be transferred to and processed in countries other than India where our service providers operate. We ensure appropriate safeguards — including standard contractual clauses — are in place to protect your personal information in accordance with the Information Technology Act, 2000 (India) and international standards such as GDPR where applicable.
If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or wish to exercise your privacy rights, please reach us:

items.def: Insta Biz Web, Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India

blocks.text: Compliance Commitment

Insta Biz Web is committed to complying with applicable data protection laws including the Information Technology Act, 2000 (India) and international standards such as GDPR where applicable. We regularly review and update our privacy practices to ensure continued compliance. For policy updates, this page will reflect the latest version with a revised “Last updated” date.

refund-policy.intro: Our refund process, eligibility criteria, and timelines — clearly explained.

blocks.text: At Insta Biz Web, we are committed to delivering high-quality digital solutions. This refund policy outlines the conditions under which refunds may be requested and processed for our services. All refund requests are subject to review and approval — this policy does not guarantee refunds but describes the circumstances under which they may be considered.
Custom Development Services

items: Website / App Development: Refund available within 5 days if project requirements are provably not met as agreed in writing
Business Automation / CRM: 30-day satisfaction guarantee after implementation and handover
Project initiation advance (30–50%): Non-refundable once discovery / planning work has commenced

blocks.text: Digital Marketing Services

items: Campaign Setup: Full refund if campaign is not launched within the agreed timeframe
Monthly Retainer Packages: Pro-rated refunds available with 15-day written notice
Initial Consulting / Strategy Session: Refund available within 48 hours if unsatisfied
Completed and delivered projects that meet agreed specifications
Third-party licences and subscriptions purchased on behalf of clients
Services where work has been completed and accepted by the client in writing
Custom development work that has been deployed to a production environment
Training and consultation services after the session has been completed
Domain registration, hosting, and third-party API fees

items.title: Contact Us
items.body: Email [[email protected]](mailto:info@instabizweb.com) with subject "Refund Request - [Project Name / Invoice Number]"

items.title: Provide Details
items.body: Include project details, invoice number, payment reference, and reason for the refund request

items.title: Review
items.body: Our team will review your request and respond within 2–3 business days with a decision

items.title: Refund Processing
items.body: Approved refunds are credited to your original payment method within the stated timelines above

blocks.text: Partial refunds may be issued in the following circumstances:

items: Project scope changes resulting in a reduction of agreed deliverables
Early termination of ongoing service retainer contracts
Unused portions of prepaid service packages (calculated pro-rata)
By mutual written agreement between Insta Biz Web and the client

blocks.text: If you disagree with a refund decision, you may request an escalated review by our management team by emailing [info@instabizweb.com](mailto:info@instabizweb.com) with “Refund Dispute” in the subject line. We are committed to resolving all disputes fairly and will respond within 3 business days.
Important Notice

All refund requests are subject to individual review and management approval. This policy outlines the circumstances under which refunds may be considered — it does not constitute an automatic entitlement. For specific questions about your project or refund eligibility, please contact our team directly before raising a formal request.
